summary: Make Deployment DSL Docker checker migration-safe

delivery.outcome: Provide a fail-closed conformance image that validates both immutable Deployment DSL manifest revisions during the coordinated migration
nonGoals: Change the Deployment DSL manifest, schema or semantics
Use a mutable branch, tag or unverified downloaded checker
Fallback to an older checker after a validation failure
Publish or merge without protected exact-head approval

architecture.decision: Package two checksum-bound checker revisions and select exactly one from an allowlist keyed by the manifest schema URI before validation
dataChanges: Add exact current DSL checker bytes alongside the existing checker
Make checker selection an explicit two-revision migration policy
architecture.rollback: Revert the Dockerfile-only commit; the old main profile continues to use its original checker.

commands: docker run --rm --network none --mount ticket-002 manifest over /workspace/dsl-manifest.json deployment-conformance
